# DELE.org

> > Official resource for DELE (Diplomas de Español como Lengua Extranjera) Spanish language certification exams administered by Instituto Cervantes and Universidad de Salamanca.

DELE.org provides comprehensive information about Spanish proficiency exams aligned with the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR), including exam dates, registration deadlines, and certification levels. The site is maintained by Instituto Cervantes in collaboration with Universidad de Salamanca and Spain's Ministry of Education, Culture and Sport.

## Key Topics

- DELE exams
- Instituto Cervantes
- Universidad de Salamanca
- Spanish language certification
- CEFR levels (A1-C2)
- Spanish proficiency testing
- Exam registration deadlines
- Spanish diplomas
- Language certification
- Spain's Ministry of Education, Culture and Sport
- Exam preparation courses
- International Spanish certification
- Language proficiency levels

## Main Information

- [DELE Exams, deadlines and exam dates | Spanish Diplomas](http://www.dele.org): Homepage: Official DELE Spanish certification exams and CEFR level info

## Language Versions

- [Exámenes DELE, plazos de inscripción y fechas | Diplomas de español](http://www.dele.org/espanol): Spanish version: DELE exam registration deadlines and dates
- [DELE-Prüfungen, Fristen und Prüfungstermines | Spanisch Diplome](http://www.dele.org/deutsch): German version: DELE exam info by Instituto Cervantes & Salamanca Univ.
- [Esame DELE 2026, scadenze e date d'esame | Diplomi di spagnolo](http://www.dele.org/italiano): Italian version: DELE 2026 exam dates by Istituto Cervantes
- [Экзамен DELE и датах экзамена | Диплом по испанскому языку](http://www.dele.org/ruskiy): Russian version: DELE Spanish language diploma and exam information
